Definition: Chaggi, an Israelite; also (patronymically) a Chaggite, or descendant of the same
BiblicalUsage: Haggi was a son of Gad, named among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob, and his family, the Haggites, was counted in the wilderness a generation later. Egypt and the wilderness are two ends of one journey, and his family is counted at both.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a son of Gad who went down to Egypt and a family still counted in the wilderness are one promise kept across two generations.
